promotion_rule: Stable primitive status requires at least two fresh cross-domain discriminator families plus one negative control and representation-invariant replay.
partial_rule: One-domain identification remains bounded and does not establish stable primitive structure.
dependency_rule: If a coordinate is deterministically implied by another retained coordinate or cannot be varied independently under admitted worlds, keep it underidentified or merge it rather than promote it.
anti_rationalization: No new X coordinate may be added to repair a failed P13 discriminator. Such a candidate may only be logged for a later stage under a new precommit.
r2_gate: Same normalized (X,G,E) conflicting action remains the only reopening gate.
